title: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Programming in Java, recursion, searching, and sorting.
prerequisites: Math 115 or placement into Calculus I.

title: Data Structures
description: Lists, trees, hash tables, and efficient searching and sorting.

title: Introduction to Discrete Structures I
description: Logic, sets, relations, induction, and mathematical proofs.

title: Introduction to Discrete Structures II
description: Counting, discrete probability, and their use in computing.
prerequisites: CS 205 or ECE 202; and Math 152.

title: Computer Architecture
description: Processor organization, memory, and input/output.
prerequisites: CS 112 or ECE 351.

title: Design and Analysis of Computer Algorithms
description: Algorithm design, correctness, and complexity.
prerequisites: CS 112 and CS 206.

title: Data Management for Data Science
description: Acquire, clean, and organize data using Python and databases.
prerequisites: CS 142 or CS 111.

title: Software Methodology
description: Object-oriented Java projects, interfaces, testing, and APIs.

title: Systems Programming
description: C and Unix programming, memory management, and processes.
prerequisites: CS 112; CS 211 is a corequisite.

title: Principles of Programming Languages
description: Compare programming paradigms and how languages are implemented.
prerequisites: CS 211 or ECE 331; CS 205 or ECE 312; and Math 152.

title: Numerical Analysis and Computing
description: Approximate numerical solutions and analyze their error.
prerequisites: Math 152 and Math 250. No credit with Math 373.

title: Numerical Methods
description: Further numerical methods; topics depend on the offering.
prerequisites: CS 323 or Math 373. No credit with Math 374.

title: Introduction to Imaging and Multimedia
description: Represent and process image, audio, and video data.
prerequisites: CS 112 or ECE 351; CS 206 or ECE 226 or Math 477; and Math 250.

title: Principles of Information and Data Management
description: Data models, database design, and SQL queries.
prerequisites: Math 152; CS 112; and CS 205 or ECE 312.

title: Internet Technology
description: Network protocols and client/server programming.
prerequisites: CS 211 or ECE 331; and CS 206 or Math 477 or ECE 321 or ECE 226.

title: Computer Architecture II
description: Advanced processor and computer organization.
prerequisites: CS 211 or ECE 331.

title: Operating Systems Design
description: Implement and analyze operating-system services.

title: Distributed Systems: Concepts and Design
description: Distributed communication, coordination, and fault tolerance.

title: Computer Security
description: Security mechanisms for computers and networks.
prerequisites: Math 152; CS 205; and CS 416 or CS 352.

title: Modeling and Simulation of Continuous Systems
description: Build and simulate models of continuous processes.
prerequisites: CS 323 or Math 373, or instructor permission.

title: Brain-Inspired Computing
description: Model neural computation and explore spiking networks.
prerequisites: CS 206; and Math 136 or Math 152.

title: Introduction to Computer Graphics
description: Represent, render, and animate computer graphics.
prerequisites: CS 112 or ECE 351; Calculus II; and Math 250. CS 323 recommended. No credit with ECE 474.

title: Software Engineering
description: Team software development from requirements through testing.
prerequisites: CS 213 and one of CS 314, 336, 352, or 416; or permission.

title: Database Systems Implementation
description: Storage, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and recovery.
prerequisites: The synopsis links CS 214 and CS 336 but does not state a complete prerequisite rule. Confirm section eligibility.

title: Introduction to Data Science
description: Prepare, explore, and model data in a complete analysis workflow.

title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: Search, knowledge representation, and automated reasoning.
prerequisites: CS 205 and Math 152.

prerequisites: Topic and prerequisites vary by section.

title: Formal Languages and Automata
description: Formal languages, machines, and limits of computation.

title: Introduction to Computational Robotics
description: Robot perception, localization, motion planning, and control.
prerequisites: CS 206 is linked as background; the synopsis does not specify a complete prerequisite rule. Confirm section eligibility.

title: Machine Learning Principles
description: Generalization, model selection, and supervised learning methods.
prerequisites: CS 206 or accepted probability equivalent. Linear algebra, calculus, and programming background; an entrance quiz may apply.

title: Introduction to Deep Learning
description: Neural networks, backpropagation, and deep-learning architectures.
prerequisites: Math 250; CS 112; and CS 206 or Math 477 or Statistics 379.

title: Independent Study in Computer Science
description: A faculty-sponsored computing or research project.
prerequisites: Faculty sponsor, project outline, and chair approval. Elective credit must be agreed in advance.

description: A faculty-sponsored computing or research project.
prerequisites: Faculty sponsor, project outline, and chair approval. Elective credit must be agreed in advance.

title: Calculus I
description: Derivatives and integrals.
prerequisites: Math 112 or Math 115, or placement.

title: Calculus II
description: Integration techniques and series.
prerequisites: Math 135 or Math 151 (not Math 130).

title: Introductory Linear Algebra
description: Matrices, linear systems, and vector spaces.
prerequisites: Math 112 or Math 115, or placement.

title: Discrete and Probabilistic Models in Biology
description: Discrete mathematics and probability in biological models.
prerequisites: Math 250, Calculus III, and Math 477 or CS 206 or Statistics 381.

title: Cryptography
description: Mathematical foundations of encryption.
prerequisites: Math 250 and Math 300 or 356 or 477.

title: Linear Optimization
description: Optimize linear objectives under constraints.
prerequisites: Math 250.

title: Graph Theory
description: Graphs and their mathematical properties.
prerequisites: Math 250 and Calculus III.

title: Combinatorics
description: Counting and discrete structures; listed as Combinatorial Theory on the CS elective list.
prerequisites: Math 250 and Calculus II.

title: Mathematical Logic
description: Formal reasoning and mathematical foundations.
prerequisites: Math 300 and Calculus III.

title: Virtual Reality
description: Virtual environments, rendering, and interaction.
prerequisites: ECE 331 or CS 211; ECE 378 lab is a corequisite.

title: Computer and Communication Networks
description: Network architectures and protocols; listed as Telecommunication Networks by CS.
prerequisites: ECE 226 or CS 206 or Math 477.

title: Introduction to Information and Network Security
description: Cryptography, authentication, and network protection.
prerequisites: ECE 226 and ECE 312.

title: Machine Learning for Engineers
description: Machine-learning methods and engineering applications.
prerequisites: Math 250 and probability: ECE 226, 14:540:210, Statistics 211 or 401, Math 477, or CS 206.

title: Introduction to Parallel and Distributed Programming
description: Parallel software for shared and distributed systems.
prerequisites: ECE 351; and ECE 331 or CS 211.

title: Software Engineering
description: Software design, development processes, and a team project.
prerequisites: ECE 351.

title: Mobile App Engineering and User Experience
description: Build mobile applications and design their user experience.
prerequisites: ECE 351.

title: Network-Centric Programming
description: Processes, sockets, and network applications on Linux.
prerequisites: ECE 351.

title: Robotics and Computer Vision
description: Robot perception, visual reconstruction, and learning.
prerequisites: ECE 345 and ECE 346.

title: Applied Symbolic Logic
description: Apply formal deduction to mathematical systems.
prerequisites: Philosophy 201.

title: Intermediate Logic I
description: Propositional and first-order logic.
prerequisites: Philosophy 201.

title: Intermediate Logic II
description: Computability and incompleteness.
prerequisites: Philosophy 407.

title: Minds, Machines, and Persons
description: Examine intelligence and personhood in humans and machines.
prerequisites: One philosophy course other than 101 or 102.

title: The Logic of Decision
description: Reason about preference, utility, and probability.

title: Linguistics and Cognitive Science
description: Connections between language and cognition.
prerequisites: Linguistics 201 and one of 305, 315, 325, or 350.

title: Intermediate Statistical Analysis
description: Statistical inference, analysis of variance, and regression.
prerequisites: Statistics 201, 211, 285, 379, or 381; or permission.

title: Regression Methods
description: Fit and assess regression models.
prerequisites: Level II statistics: 212, 384, 401, 484, 291, or equivalent.

title: Introduction to Sampling
description: Design and analyze sample surveys.
prerequisites: Statistics 379 or 381, equivalent, or permission.

title: Applied Statistical Learning
description: Computational methods for learning from data; formerly Computing and Graphics in Applied Statistics.
prerequisites: Level II statistics: 212, 384, 401, 484, 291, or equivalent.
